faq.question: Can you put an Apple AirTag in checked luggage?
faq.answer: Yes! The FAA, TSA, EASA, Air France, Lufthansa, and Emirates all officially permit Apple AirTags and CR2032 button-cell trackers inside checked suitcases.

faq.question: Do AirTags violate lithium battery checked bag rules?
faq.answer: No. FAA and ICAO regulations state that low-power tracking devices containing lithium coin cells with under 0.3g lithium metal (like CR2032) do not present a fire risk and are exempt from battery restrictions.
